extraction.document_summary: Singlife Comprehensive Critical Illness II is a single-payout critical illness plan that pays a one-time lump sum when you are diagnosed with any of the 135 covered critical illness conditions across early, intermediate and severe stages. The core payout is 100% of your Sum Assured. The brochure also provides add-on payouts that can increase total benefits depending on the event: (1) a further additional 20% of Sum Assured for surgical removal of a Benign Tumour (suspected malignancy) or diagnosis of a Borderline Malignant Tumour, capped at S$25,000; (2) if you spend 4 days or more in the ICU in one hospital admission, you receive an additional 20% of Sum Assured, capped at S$25,000; and (3) a Special Benefit for 27 conditions pays an additional 20% of Sum Assured up to S$25,000 per life per condition, with a maximum of six claims. It also states a death payout of S$5,000 during the coverage period. Key buyer caveats include claim limits (e.g., only one claim under certain benefits, and the Special Benefit has a per-condition and total-claim maximum) and that waiting period and survival period are applicable.
quality_notes: Main benefits and caps are stated clearly (100% Sum Assured, additional 20% with S$25,000 caps, and death payout of S$5,000).
Eligibility ages (entry age range) are not explicitly stated; only benefit cessation ages and coverage-period choices are described.
Underwriting level, medical exam requirement, free-look/grace period, and exclusions are not explicitly provided in the brochure text supplied.

policies.quick_summary: Single-payout critical illness plan: pays 100% of Sum Assured as a lump sum on diagnosis of 135 covered critical illnesses (across early/intermediate/severe stages). Additional benefits may pay extra 20% of Sum Assured for specified events (benign/borderline tumours, ICU stay ≥4 days, and a Special Benefit for 27 conditions), each subject to caps and claim limits. Death during coverage period pays S$5,000. Coverage period can be chosen from 10 years up to age 99 (in 1-year intervals) and payout limits can be converted if not in SGD. Waiting and survival periods are stated as applicable for certain benefits.
coverage_scope: Diagnosis of covered critical illnesses across various stages (early, intermediate, severe) among 135 conditions
Additional payouts for: surgical removal of Benign Tumour (suspected malignancy) or Borderline Malignant Tumour
Additional payout for ICU stay of 4 days or more within a single hospital admission in Singapore
Additional payout for 27 covered conditions under the Special Benefit
Lump-sum payout upon death during the coverage period
policies.residency_requirements: ICU-related benefit specifies ICU stay must be in Singapore and confirmed as Necessary Medical Treatment.
policies.eligibility_notes: Brochure says ages mentioned refer to age next birthday.
policies.coverage_term_description: Choose coverage period any duration from 10 years up till you’re 99 years old (in one-year intervals).
policy_termination_events: For certain benefits: on the Policy Anniversary in which the Life Assured is 85 years old, or upon the expiry of the Policy, whichever is earliest
For ICU benefit: on the date on which a claim is made, on the Policy Anniversary in which the Life Assured is 85 years old, or upon the expiry of the Policy, whichever is earliest

For Special Benefit: on the date on which the sixth claim is made, on the Policy Anniversary in which the Life Assured is 18 or 85 years old (based on covered conditions), or upon the expiry of the Policy, whichever is earliest
important_caveats: Core critical illness payout is a one-time lump sum; the brochure describes claim limits (e.g., only one claim allowed under certain benefits).
Waiting period and survival period are applicable for the benefits described as having those terms.

ICU benefit: ICU stay of 4 days or more must be in one hospital admission in Singapore and must be confirmed as Necessary Medical Treatment; ICU is not considered Necessary Medical Treatment if the Life Assured can be safely and adequately treated in any other facility.
Special Benefit: only one claim is payable for each condition and a maximum of six claims is allowed under this benefit; the benefit ceases upon the sixth claim or specific age/expiry timing.

Currency conversion: if coverage amount is not in Singapore dollars, benefit limits stated in Singapore dollars are converted to the equivalent amount in chosen currency based on the insurer’s currency conversion rate.

evidence.quote: If you’re diagnosed with any of the covered 135 conditions across various stages of critical illnesses1, you’ll get a lump-sum payout that’s 100% of your Sum Assured.
Only one claim is allowed under this benefit. An additional 20% of Sum Assured will be payable subject to a cap of S$25,000 (or equivalent currency) per life.

This benefit shall cease on the date on which a claim is made, on the Policy Anniversary in which the Life Assured is 85 years old, or upon the expiry of the Policy, whichever is earliest. Waiting period and survival period are applicable.

benefits.benefit_name: Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Benefit (additional 20% capped at S$25,000)
benefits.benefit_description: Additional payout for spending at least 4 days in the ICU within a single hospital admission (in Singapore). Pays additional 20% of Sum Assured, capped at S$25,000.
benefits.trigger_description: Spend 4 days or more in the Intensive Care Unit within a single hospital admission.
benefits.payout_description: Additional 20% of your Sum Assured (up to S$25,000).
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: Benefit ceases on the date on which a claim is made, on the Policy Anniversary in which the Life Assured is 85 years old, or upon expiry of the Policy (whichever is earliest).

A stay will not be considered Necessary Medical Treatment if the Life Assured can be safely and adequately treated in any other facility. Waiting period and survival period are applicable.

source_evidence.quote: Singlife Comprehensive Critical Illness II provides a one-time lump-sum payout upon diagnosis of critical illnesses across various stages, from early detection to severe diagnosis, along with added benefits to help you recover with peace of mind.
